page: Microsoft Azure DC4eds_v6 is a virtual machine configuration running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and utilizes an Intel processor to provide 4 dedicated vCPUs alongside 16.0 GB of memory, establishing a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The server includes 236 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage, offering low-latency temporary read and write capabilities, while supporting Azure Premium Storage for persistent volume attachments. It does not include hardware-accelerated GPUs.

From an infrastructure standpoint, the dedicated vCPU allocation provides consistent execution cycles without the risk of CPU throttling common to shared-core or burstable tiers. The inclusion of 236 GB of high-speed local NVMe storage reduces external disk latency for caching layers and scratch processing. However, network configuration requires explicit planning, as the instance includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating external routing or private networking setups.

With a balanced distribution of compute, memory, and fast local NVMe storage, the DC4eds_v6 delivers practical resource density for mid-sized enterprise environments. It is well aligned with workloads such as relational database backends, application runtime servers, containerized services, and CI/CD build environments that benefit from direct solid-state storage.
description: Microsoft Azure DC4eds_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine deployed on Microsoft Hyper-V. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor, the instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. Its storage architecture features 236 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD space for high-throughput scratch operations and supports Premium Storage capabilities for persistent data. The instance does not bundle graphics accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. With dedicated processing cores delivering consistent execution and local solid-state drives providing fast I/O throughput, the DC4eds_v6 offers balanced resource density and operational efficiency. It is well structured for relational database hosting, containerized microservices, development environments, and mid-sized web applications that require dependable CPU performance coupled with responsive ephemeral local storage.
